description.en: Watches the context budget of a DeepSeek Harness session (colour dot per turn, reminder plus one-click new-session handoff at orange/red, /context-watch and /handoff commands), reading local session files only.
description.zh: 看护 DeepSeek Harness 会话的上下文预算（每轮颜色点、橙/红档提醒与一键开新会话交接、/context-watch 与 /handoff 命令），只读本地会话文件。
